untrustedWorkspaces.description: Hover explanations require an indexed workspace. In untrusted workspaces, indexing and sidecar-based generation are disabled until the workspace is trusted.

commands.title: LucidHover: Refresh Explanation for Function Under Cursor
LucidHover: Restart Sidecar (Apply Ollama Endpoint Setting)

lucidHover.backgroundFlushIntervalSecond.description: How often (in seconds) LucidHover checks functions edited but not yet saved and regenerates their explanations in the background.

lucidHover.modelId.description: Ollama model name to use for generation, e.g. "qwen3:8b". Leave empty to use the bundled default (qwen2.5-coder:1.5b). Takes effect on the next hover/save/refresh -- no restart needed. Changing this invalidates the cache for every function, since model_id is part of the cache key.

lucidHover.ollamaEndpoint.description: Local Ollama endpoint to use instead of the bundled http://localhost:11434, e.g. to point at a custom local model. Must be a local address (localhost/127.0.0.1/::1) -- LucidHover is fully local and will reject and ignore any other host, including cloud-hosted Ollama endpoints. Leave empty to use the default. This is spawn-time config: run "LucidHover: Restart Sidecar" (or reload the window) after changing it.
